data.title: Bitcoin jumps 42.9% in Q3 2026, leaving gold and stocks behind
data.description: Bitcoin gained 42.9% in the third quarter of 2026. Gold, stocks and nearly everything else spent the same stretch looking on from a distance.The rally ended a three-quarter losing streak. It also gave Bitcoin its best third quarter since 2017, which is a long time to wait for a summer worth remembe…
